description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Generator, which generates HTML output from tokens, including handling of attributes, script content, and optional tidying and newline normalization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating HTML from tokens, with support for XHTML, script handling, attribute generation, and optional tidying.

methods.name: generateFromTokens
methods.description: Generates HTML from an array of tokens, with optional tidying and newline normalization.

methods.name: generateFromToken
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single token, handling different token types such as start, end, empty, text, and comment.

methods.name: generateScriptFromToken
methods.description: Processes script content tokens to safely embed JavaScript code within HTML comments and CDATA sections.

methods.name: generateAttributes
methods.description: Creates attribute strings from attribute arrays, with options for sorting, minimization, and IE-specific fixes.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes raw text data for safe HTML output using htmlspecialchars.
